Widget 2.0 Released

By Jane Doe · 2026-11-12

Widget 2.0 is out today. It is twice as fast and adds a new widget.run() API.

What changed

  1. Faster startup
  2. New API
    • run()
    • stop()
  3. Fewer dependencies

Benchmarks

VersionStartup
1.0120 ms
2.060 ms

Upgrade

pip install --upgrade widget
widget --version   # prints 2.0

The best release yet.
